sources.title: OpceanAI/Qwen3.5-0.8B-abliterated · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The interesting part is not that it works. Many abliterated Qwen3.5-0.8B releases exist, and most report a refusal rate near zero. The interesting part is that this one ships the measurement: seven refusal categories, three jailbreak templates, twelve capability measurements with confidence intervals, and a significance test for every comparison.
